'''Joe Kollisch BHBM Killa Style''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Joe Kollisch]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-14406">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14406 BHBM  Killa Style], DeckTech (Joe "Mirax" Kollisch, 8 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14406/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14406/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018033900/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14406/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Joe Kollisch]]
* '''Published:''' 8 March 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''BHBM  Killa Style''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 BHBM Kollisch DS 2001 14406.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Fast Activation.Battle and Drain.Then duel,duel,and duel some more.

== Original post ==

'''BHBM  Killa Style'''
* '''Author:''' Joe "Mirax" Kollisch
* '''Published:''' March 8, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' Fast Activation.Battle and Drain.Then duel,duel,and duel some more.

=== Strategy ===

Well whatever you are playin agaist u drop charcters for fast activation pulling a DB every turn.If you don't have Vader in hand start searchin for him.Make a nice force on the ground and start force drainin and make em' lose force to search and destroy once u get that goin...when u get luke and maybe win a battle or 2 bring luke to the thrown room(if they aint there already)Duel with the high destinies drain of 3 with his saber...janus...and presence at the thrown room...that tends to hurt after awile.this deck is meant to duel and battle not so much to cross luke but to cause damage.Thanx for your time and Peace out
